note: In speech 由 jau4 is more common for 'from'. 從來 = ever, always.

ex.r: ngo5 cung4 sai3 zau6 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: I've loved swimming since I was little.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 cung4 tau4 zoi3 lai4 gwo3 laa1
ex.en: Let's start over from the beginning.

ex.r: keoi5 cung4 loi4 m4 sik6 laat6
ex.en: He never eats spicy food.

en: to go away; to step away
note: Can sound rude on its own; 行開啲 is a softer 'move aside'.

ex.r: nei5 zau2 hoi1 laa1 ngo5 soeng2 zing6 jat1 zing6
ex.en: Go away, I want some quiet.

ex.r: lou5 sai3 ngaam1 ngaam1 zau2 hoi1 zo2
ex.en: The boss just stepped away.

ex.r: zek3 maau1 gin3 dou2 gau2 zau6 zau2 hoi1 zo2
ex.en: The cat walked off when it saw the dog.

note: Spoken with colloquial seng2.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 tai4 seng2 ngo5 maai5 ngau4 naai5 aa3
ex.en: Remember to remind me to buy milk.

ex.r: sau2 gei1 wui5 tai4 seng2 nei5 sik6 joek6
ex.en: Your phone will remind you to take your medicine.

ex.r: do1 ze6 nei5 tai4 seng2 ngo5 hoi1 wui2
ex.en: Thanks for reminding me about the meeting.

ex.r: ni1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 gaau3 fan3
ex.en: This was really a lesson.

ex.s: 我學到教訓，以後唔會遲到。
ex.r: ngo5 hok6 dou2 gaau3 fan3 ji5 hau6 m4 wui5 ci4 dou3
ex.en: I learned my lesson; I won't be late again.

ex.r: maa1 mi4 gaau3 fan3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 caan1
ex.en: Mom gave him a good telling-off.

note: At weddings, 一對新人 = the bride and groom.

ex.r: gung1 si1 lai4 zo2 go3 san1 jan4
ex.en: A new hire joined the company.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 san1 jan4 nei5 bong1 haa5 keoi5 laa1
ex.en: She's new here; give her a hand.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 ging3 san1 jan4 jat1 bui1
ex.en: Let's all toast the newlyweds!

note: 餐廳 caan1 teng1 is the more common everyday word.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 gun2 di1 je5 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The food at this restaurant is great.

ex.r: fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 caan1 gun2 aa3
ex.en: Are there any restaurants nearby?

ex.s: 佢喺一間意大利餐館做嘢。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 ji3 daai6 lei6 caan1 gun2 zou6 je5
ex.en: She works at an Italian restaurant.

note: 動物園 = zoo.

ex.r: sai3 lou6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 dung6 mat6
ex.en: Kids love looking at animals.

ex.r: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 me1 dung6 mat6 aa3
ex.en: What's your favorite animal?

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 m4 zeon2 daai3 dung6 mat6
ex.en: This hotel doesn't allow animals.

note: 影印機 = photocopier.

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 jing2 jan3 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 aa1
ex.en: Please photocopy this document for me.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 jing2 jan3 san1 fan2 zing3
ex.en: I need to photocopy my ID card.

ex.s: 圖書館可以影印，一蚊一張。
ex.r: tou4 syu1 gun2 ho2 ji5 jing2 jan3 jat1 man1 jat1 zoeng1
ex.en: You can photocopy at the library, a dollar a page.

note: Also a verb: to stimulate, to provoke.

ex.r: gwo3 saan1 ce1 hou2 ci3 gik1 aa3
ex.en: The roller coaster is so thrilling!

ex.r: cam4 maan5 coeng4 bo1 hou2 ci3 gik1
ex.en: Last night's match was really exciting.

ex.s: 呢套戲好刺激，你一定要睇。
ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 ci3 gik1 nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tai2
ex.en: This movie is really thrilling; you have to see it.

note: 方向感 = sense of direction.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai6 mai6 haang4 co3 fong1 hoeng3 aa3
ex.en: Are we going the wrong way?

ex.r: dei6 tit3 zaam6 hai2 go2 go3 fong1 hoeng3
ex.en: The MTR station is in that direction.

ex.r: ngo5 mou5 mat1 fong1 hoeng3 gam2
ex.en: I don't have much sense of direction.

note: Often paired with 就: 既然…就….

ex.s: 既然落雨，我哋留喺屋企啦。
ex.r: gei3 jin4 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: Since it's raining, let's stay home.

ex.s: 既然你唔舒服，就早啲走啦。
ex.r: gei3 jin4 nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6 zau6 zou2 di1 zau2 laa1
ex.en: Since you're not feeling well, leave early.

ex.r: gei3 jin4 maai5 zo2 zau6 jung6 laa1
ex.en: Since you've bought it, just use it.

note: For photos people usually say 相 soeng2.

ex.r: nei5 cyun4 zoeng1 tou4 pin2 bei2 ngo5 aa1
ex.en: Send me the picture.

ex.r: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 hou2 do1 tou4 pin2
ex.en: This book has lots of pictures.

ex.s: 網上啲圖片唔一定係真嘅。
ex.r: mong5 soeng6 di1 tou4 pin2 m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 zan1 ge3
ex.en: Pictures online aren't always real.

ex.r: nei5 gu2 dou2 daap3 on3 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you guessed the answer yet?

ex.r: ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 daap3 on3
ex.en: I don't know the answer either.

ex.r: haau2 jyun4 si5 sin1 tai2 daap3 on3 laa1
ex.en: Check the answers after the exam.

note: 娛樂圈 = show business.

ex.r: nei5 ping4 si4 jau5 me1 jyu4 lok6 aa3
ex.en: What do you usually do for fun?

ex.r: ni1 dou6 je6 maan5 mou5 mat1 jyu4 lok6
ex.en: There isn't much entertainment here at night.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jyu4 lok6 hyun1 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4
ex.en: She's worked in show business for ten years.

note: Female form: 師姐 si1 ze2.

ex.r: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 daai6 hok6 ge3 si1 hing1
ex.en: This is my senior from university.

ex.r: jau5 m4 ming4 ho2 ji5 man6 si1 hing1
ex.en: If you don't understand, ask a senior colleague.

ex.r: si1 hing1 gaau3 ngo5 daa2 gung1 fu1
ex.en: My senior classmate teaches me kung fu.

note: 私家車 = private car; 私家醫院 = private hospital.

ex.r: keoi5 zaa1 si1 gaa1 ce1 faan1 gung1
ex.en: He drives his own car to work.

ex.r: si1 gaa1 ji1 jyun2 gwai3 hou2 do1
ex.en: Private hospitals are much more expensive.

ex.s: 呢條係私家路，唔可以入。
ex.r: ni1 tiu4 hai6 si1 gaa1 lou6 m4 ho2 ji5 jap6
ex.en: This is a private road; you can't go in.

note: In casual speech 啱 ngaam1 is more common.

ex.r: nei5 go3 daap3 on3 hai6 zing3 kok3 ge3
ex.en: Your answer is correct.

ex.r: cing2 syu1 jap6 zing3 kok3 ge3 mat6 maa5
ex.en: Please enter the correct password.

ex.s: 佢做咗一個正確嘅決定。
ex.r: keoi5 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 zing3 kok3 ge3 kyut3 ding6
ex.en: She made the right decision.

note: 中年人 = middle-aged person.

ex.r: ngo5 baa4 baa1 ji5 ging1 zung1 nin4 laa3
ex.en: My dad is already middle-aged.

ex.r: jau5 go3 zung1 nin4 naam4 jan2 wan2 nei5
ex.en: A middle-aged man is looking for you.

ex.s: 人到中年要多啲做運動。
ex.r: jan4 dou3 zung1 nin4 jiu3 do1 di1 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: In middle age you should exercise more.

note: Measure word 嚿 gau6 or 粒 nap1 (pebble). 石頭 is also common.

ex.r: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 hou2 deng3 sek6 aa3
ex.en: Kids, don't throw stones!

ex.r: ngo5 haai4 jap6 min6 jau5 nap1 sek6
ex.en: There's a pebble in my shoe.

ex.r: saa1 taan1 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 sek6
ex.en: There are lots of rocks on the beach.

ex.r: ngo5 go3 zai2 hoi1 ci2 sik1 paa4 laa3
ex.en: My son has started crawling.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 paa4 saan1
ex.en: We're going mountain climbing tomorrow.

ex.r: zek3 maau1 paa4 zo2 soeng5 syu6
ex.en: The cat climbed up the tree.

ex.s: 佢係一個藝術家，識畫畫。
ex.r: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 sik1 waak6 waa2
ex.en: She's an artist; she paints.

ex.s: 呢個展覽有好多本地藝術家。
ex.r: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 jau5 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1
ex.en: This exhibition features many local artists.

ex.s: 我個仔大個想做藝術家。
ex.r: ngo5 go3 zai2 daai6 go3 soeng2 zou6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1
ex.en: My son wants to be an artist when he grows up.

note: Used like 月入三萬 = earns 30,000 a month.

ex.r: keoi5 jyut6 jap6 daai6 koi3 saam1 maan6
ex.en: He earns about thirty thousand a month.

ex.s: 月入兩萬喺香港好難過。
ex.r: jyut6 jap6 loeng5 maan6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 naan4 gwo3
ex.en: It's hard to get by in Hong Kong on twenty thousand a month.

ex.r: fan6 gung1 jyut6 jap6 gei2 do1 aa3
ex.en: How much does the job pay a month?

ex.s: 星期日一齊去博物館吖。
ex.r: sing1 kei4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 bok3 mat6 gun2 aa1
ex.en: Let's go to the museum together on Sunday.

ex.r: bok3 mat6 gun2 gei2 dim2 saan1 mun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the museum close?

ex.s: 學校帶我哋去參觀博物館。
ex.r: hok6 haau6 daai3 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 caam1 gun1 bok3 mat6 gun2
ex.en: The school took us to visit a museum.

note: 救命呀！ is the shout for help; also used jokingly.

ex.r: gau3 meng6 aa3 jau5 jan4 dit3 zo2 lok6 seoi2
ex.en: Help! Someone fell into the water!

ex.r: nei5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gau3 meng6 jan1 jan4
ex.en: You're my lifesaver!

ex.s: 救命，我今日有三個測驗！
ex.r: gau3 meng6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 saam1 go3 caak1 jim6
ex.en: Help me, I have three quizzes today!

ex.s: 隻狗病咗，要帶佢睇獸醫。
ex.r: zek3 gau2 beng6 zo2 jiu3 daai3 keoi5 tai2 sau3 ji1
ex.en: The dog's sick; we need to take him to the vet.

ex.r: ngo5 biu2 mui2 duk6 gan2 sau3 ji1
ex.en: My cousin is studying to be a vet.

ex.r: tai2 sau3 ji1 hou2 gwai3 gaa3
ex.en: Going to the vet is expensive.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 fan1 daam1 gaa1 mou6 laa1
ex.en: Let's share the housework.

ex.r: zou1 gam1 saam1 go3 jan4 fan1 daam1
ex.en: Three people split the rent.

ex.s: 有咩煩惱同我講，我幫你分擔。
ex.r: jau5 me1 faan4 nou5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 fan1 daam1
ex.en: Tell me what's bothering you; I'll help you carry it.

en: to try one's luck; to strive
note: 搏一搏 = take a chance; 搏命 = work like crazy.

ex.r: m4 zi1 jau5 mou5 wai2 bok3 haa5 laa1
ex.en: Not sure there are seats; let's try our luck.

ex.r: keoi5 jat6 jat6 bok3 meng6 zou6 je5
ex.en: He works like crazy every day.

ex.r: maai5 zoeng1 luk6 hap6 coi2 bok3 jat1 bok3
ex.en: Buy a Mark Six ticket and take a chance.

note: Measure word for rounds: 打一鋪麻雀. 今鋪 = this time.

ex.r: zoi3 lai4 jat1 pou1 laa1
ex.en: One more round!

ex.r: gam1 pou1 ngo5 sat6 jeng4
ex.en: I'm definitely winning this round.

ex.s: 佢哋打咗成晚麻雀，輸咗幾鋪。
ex.r: keoi5 dei6 daa2 zo2 seng4 maan5 maa4 zoek2 syu1 zo2 gei2 pou1
ex.en: They played mahjong all night and lost a few rounds.

ex.r: nei5 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3 hou2 caa1
ex.en: Your tone is really rude.

ex.r: teng1 keoi5 jyu5 hei3 hou2 ci5 m4 hoi1 sam1
ex.en: From his tone, he seems upset.

ex.s: 打電話畀客人，語氣要好啲。
ex.r: daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 haak3 jan4 jyu5 hei3 jiu3 hou2 di1
ex.en: When you call customers, use a nicer tone.

note: Also written 過分.

ex.r: nei5 gam3 gong2 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6
ex.en: Saying that is really going too far.

ex.s: 佢遲咗兩個鐘，太過份喇！
ex.r: keoi5 ci4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 taai3 gwo3 fan6 laa3
ex.en: He was two hours late — that's too much!

ex.r: m4 hou2 jam2 dak1 gwo3 fan6 aa3
ex.en: Don't drink too much.

en: to depend on; to rely on

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 ji1 laai6 keoi5 maa1 mi4
ex.en: He really depends on his mom.

ex.r: m4 hou2 taai3 ji1 laai6 sau2 gei1
ex.en: Don't rely on your phone too much.

ex.s: 我想搵工，唔想依賴屋企人。
ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 wan2 gung1 m4 soeng2 ji1 laai6 uk1 kei2 jan4
ex.en: I want to find a job; I don't want to depend on my family.

note: 好心你啦 = for goodness' sake (exasperated).

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 hou2 sam1 seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4
ex.en: She's very kind; she's always helping people.

ex.s: 多謝你好心送我返屋企。
ex.r: do1 ze6 nei5 hou2 sam1 sung3 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2
ex.en: Thanks for kindly taking me home.

ex.r: hou2 sam1 nei5 laa1 zap1 haa5 nei5 gaan1 fong2
ex.en: For goodness' sake, tidy your room!

note: Same idea as 竟然 ging2 jin4.

ex.r: keoi5 geoi1 jin4 gei3 dak1 ngo5 saang1 jat6
ex.en: He actually remembered my birthday!

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 geoi1 jin4 mou5 hoi1
ex.en: Surprisingly, this shop isn't open.

ex.r: sap6 jyut6 geoi1 jin4 zung6 gam3 jit6
ex.en: It's surprisingly still this hot in October.

note: 剃鬚 = shave one's beard.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 mou5 si4 gaan3 tai3 sou1
ex.en: I didn't have time to shave this morning.

ex.r: keoi5 tai3 zo2 gwong1 tau4
ex.en: He shaved his head.

ex.r: sau3 ji1 jiu3 bong1 zek3 gau2 tai3 mou4
ex.en: The vet needs to shave the dog's fur.

note: 業餘時間 = spare time outside work.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 jip6 jyu4 sip3 jing2 si1
ex.en: He's an amateur photographer.

ex.r: nei5 jip6 jyu4 si4 gaan3 zou6 me1 aa3
ex.en: What do you do in your spare time?

ex.s: 我哋係業餘波隊，玩下啫。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai6 jip6 jyu4 bo1 deoi2 waan2 haa5 ze1
ex.en: We're an amateur team, just for fun.

en: to add; plus; on top of that

ex.s: 加上服務費，一共五百蚊。
ex.r: gaa1 soeng5 fuk6 mou6 fai3 jat1 gung6 ng5 baak3 man1
ex.en: With the service charge, it's 500 dollars in total.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 gui6 gaa1 soeng5 jau5 di1 faat3 siu1
ex.en: She's exhausted, and on top of that she has a slight fever.

ex.s: 落雨加上塞車，梗係遲到啦。
ex.r: lok6 jyu5 gaa1 soeng5 sak1 ce1 gang2 hai6 ci4 dou3 laa1
ex.en: Rain plus traffic — of course we were late.

ex.r: faai3 di1 sik6 syut3 gou1 jung4 laa3
ex.en: Eat quickly, the ice cream is melting!

ex.r: di1 tong4 jung4 zo2 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Has the sugar dissolved yet?

ex.s: 今日熱到啲朱古力都溶晒。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 jit6 dou3 di1 zyu1 gu1 lik1 dou1 jung4 saai3
ex.en: It's so hot today the chocolate all melted.

en: to adapt; to get used to
note: 適應唔到 = can't get used to it.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 jing3 zo2 san1 gung1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you settled into your new job yet?

ex.s: 我仲未適應呢度嘅天氣。
ex.r: ngo5 zung6 mei6 sik1 jing3 ni1 dou6 ge3 tin1 hei3
ex.en: I'm still not used to the weather here.

ex.r: sai3 lou6 hou2 faai3 sik1 jing3 san1 hok6 haau6
ex.en: Kids adapt to a new school very quickly.

en: out of the blue; for no reason
note: Very colloquial.

ex.r: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 haam3 hei2 soeng5 lai4
ex.en: She suddenly started crying for no reason.

ex.r: bou6 din6 nou5 mou4 laa1 laa1 sik1 zo2
ex.en: The computer shut off out of nowhere.

ex.s: 你無啦啦送花畀我做乜呀？
ex.r: nei5 mou4 laa1 laa1 sung3 faa1 bei2 ngo5 zou6 mat1 aa3
ex.en: Why are you giving me flowers out of the blue?

note: 親眼見到 = saw it oneself.

ex.r: ngo5 can1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 to1 sau2
ex.en: I saw them holding hands with my own eyes.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 can1 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 coeng4 sing4
ex.en: I want to see the Great Wall with my own eyes.

ex.r: nei5 m4 seon3 zau6 can1 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 laa1
ex.en: If you don't believe me, see for yourself.

note: Colloquial ceng1, as in 青菜 and 青色.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 di1 ceng1 coi3
ex.en: I want to eat some greens.

ex.r: keoi5 gin6 ceng1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 hou2 leng3
ex.en: Her green jacket is really nice.

ex.r: nei5 faai3 min6 hou2 ceng1 mou5 si6 aa1 maa3
ex.en: You look really pale — are you okay?

ex.r: keoi5 mau1 hai2 dei6 haa2 bong2 haai4 daai2
ex.en: He's squatting on the ground tying his shoelaces.

ex.r: m4 hou2 mau1 hai2 dou6 co5 dai1 laa1
ex.en: Don't squat there; sit down.

ex.r: mau1 noi6 zo2 goek3 hou2 bei3
ex.en: Squatting too long made my legs go numb.

note: 固定工作 = steady job.

ex.r: keoi5 mou5 gu3 ding6 gung1 zok3
ex.en: He doesn't have a steady job.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 gu3 ding6 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1
ex.en: I get up at seven every day without fail.

ex.r: zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 gu3 ding6 hou2 sin1 dak1
ex.en: The table needs to be fixed firmly in place.

note: 綠色 = green; 綠燈 = green light.

ex.r: luk6 dang1 sin1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 maa5 lou6
ex.en: Only cross the road on a green light.

ex.r: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 luk6 sik1
ex.en: Green is my favorite color.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gung1 jyun2 hou2 luk6 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: This park is so green and pleasant.

note: Also figurative: 呢件事好頭痛 = this is a headache.

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 di1 tau4 tung3 soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5
ex.en: I have a bit of a headache; I want to rest.

ex.r: tau4 tung3 zau6 sik6 nap1 zi2 tung3 joek6 laa1
ex.en: If you have a headache, take a painkiller.

ex.r: wan2 uk1 zyu6 zan1 hai6 hou2 tau4 tung3
ex.en: Finding a place to live is a real headache.

note: 片 is pin2 when it means a movie.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 gau6 gong2 caan2 pin2
ex.en: I love watching old Hong Kong films.

ex.s: 學廣東話可以睇港產片。
ex.r: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ho2 ji5 tai2 gong2 caan2 pin2
ex.en: You can watch Hong Kong movies to learn Cantonese.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 din6 si6 jau5 tou3 gong2 caan2 pin2
ex.en: There's a Hong Kong movie on TV tonight.

note: 練琴 = practice piano.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 lin6 kam4 jat1 go3 zung1
ex.en: I practice piano for an hour every day.

ex.r: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 gin6 san1 sat1 lin6 gei1 juk6
ex.en: He went to the gym to build muscle.

ex.r: gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jiu3 do1 di1 lin6
ex.en: You need to practice speaking Cantonese more.

note: 砧板 = chopping board; 滑板 = skateboard; 地板 = floor.

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 lo2 faai3 zam1 baan2 lai4
ex.en: Get me the chopping board.

ex.r: keoi5 fong3 hok6 wui5 heoi3 waan2 waat6 baan2
ex.en: He goes skateboarding after school.

ex.r: dei6 baan2 hou2 waat6 siu2 sam1 aa3
ex.en: The floor is slippery; be careful.

note: Casual, can sound mocking; 有錢人 is neutral.

ex.s: 佢中咗六合彩，變咗有錢佬。
ex.r: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 bin3 zo2 jau5 cin2 lou2
ex.en: He won the Mark Six and became a rich guy.

ex.r: ni1 keoi1 zyu6 saai3 di1 jau5 cin2 lou2
ex.en: This area is full of rich people.

ex.s: 我又唔係有錢佬，買唔起呀。
ex.r: ngo5 jau6 m4 hai6 jau5 cin2 lou2 maai5 m4 hei2 aa3
ex.en: I'm not some rich guy; I can't afford it.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 jau4 guk2 gei3 seon3
ex.en: I need to go to the post office to mail a letter.

ex.r: jau4 guk2 gei2 dim2 hoi1 mun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the post office open?
